name: 77 K micro-JT cooler stabilization for a terahertz detector
plain_name: 77 K micro-JT cooler stabilization for a terahertz detector
description: Evaluate whether the documented mixed-refrigerant microcooler can support stable 77 K THz-detector operation. Its known temperature oscillation issue must remain visible.

reported_conditions.as_printed: 77 K achieved; oscillations below about 140 K

requirements.rationale: This selected procedure evaluates the micro-JT architecture.
Stable integrated detector operation is required by the application but not established by reaching 77 K; this must stay UNKNOWN until supported.

missing_information: Stable 77 K operation, loaded cooling power and integrated THz detector readout are unestablished. A demonstrated unloaded cold tip is not a verified detector system.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
